exposure: oxygen therapy delivery methods (non-invasive positive ventilation)
fluctuation of partial pressure of oxygen
cohort: The study included low-risk preterm neonates (gestational age >=30 weeks and birth weight >=1 kg) treated for ROP.
finding: Mean partial pressure of oxygen (<52.8%) and its fluctuation (>82.3%) were significant risk factors for A-ROP in low-risk preterm neonates.
